game.name: Pictionary - Ultimate Edition
game.desc:
1,500 all new clues, plus ability to create customized clues Customizable Pictionary Man game pieces Sleek new design with holographic elements Seven new play types within Pictionary Mania mode New Family Fun mode allowing customization of rules
With Pictionary: Ultimate Edition, enjoy the high-tech spin and whole new way to play your favorite game of quick sketches and crazy guesses! An HD experience complete with all-new game modes, touch screen gestures, and a customizable Pictionary Man game piece leads to endless hours of family fun!
